.evWrap {position:relative; width:100%; overflow:hidden; z-index:0; font-family:Pretendard, 'Noto Sans Regular';}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav_inner {position:relative; width:100%; height:14.66667vw; margin:0 auto; padding:0 8vw; background:#5B5332; overflow:hidden;}

._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav a {position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; width:auto; height:100%; font-size:4vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; color:#FFFFFF; opacity:0.6; white-space:nowrap;}
._info_nav_flex ._nav_wrap ._nav._current span::after {content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; height:0.66667vw; background:#FFFFFF;}
._info_nav_flex._fixed ._nav_wrap {position:fixed; left:0; top:50px;/* <<<<<50 px 단위 고정 */ width:100%; z-index:100;}
._evt_content ._page_title {display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:1.6vw; width:100%; padding:0 6.66667vw; text-align:center;}

._must_slider ._must_item ._copy {position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:1.06667vw; width:100%; height:26.53333vw; padding-top:7.2vw; background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 0, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%); color:#FFFFFF; text-align:center;}
._must_slider ._prd ._thumb {flex:0 0 16vw; display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; width:16vw; height:16vw; background:#FFFFFF; overflow:hidden;}
._must_slider ._prd ._brand {display:block; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:3.46667vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.104vw; line-height:normal;}
._must_slider ._prd ._product {display:block; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.1vw; line-height:normal;}
._arrival_wrap ._brand_name {display:flex; align-items:center; height:8vw; padding:0 6.66667vw; font-size:6.66667vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.13333vw; line-height:normal; color:#121212;}
._arrival_wrap ._look_item ._name {display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.6vw; font-size:3.46667vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.06933vw; line-height:normal;}
._sale_slider ._col {flex:0 0 auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5.33333vw; width:32vw; margin-right:5.33333vw;}

._sale_slider ._item ._per {position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); width:100%; font-size:8vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0; line-height:9.6vw; color:#FFF600; text-align:center;}

._sale_slider ._item ._name {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:1.46667vw; min-height:4.8vw; font-size:4vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:normal; text-align:center;}
._gift_list {display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 41.33333vw); justify-content:space-between; row-gap:6vw; width:86.66667vw; margin:10.66667vw auto 0;}
._gift_list ._item ._name {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:1.46667vw; font-size:4vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:normal;}
._evt_footer {display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:2.4vw; width:100%; height:14.66667vw; padding:0 8vw; background:#000000;}
